⌈

the classes in ara::core specified below in terms of the corresponding classes of the
C++ standard, all functions that are specified by [5, the C++11 standard], [6, the C++17
standard], or [7, the draft C++20 standard] to throw any exceptions, are instead speci-
fied to be the cause of a Violation when they do so.
